title: DR1 labels the date on a notification card "Arrival date at destination"; the frontend labels it "Arrival at destination".

finding.frontend: The third pair on the card's first row is labelled "Arrival at destination" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:20). The value under it is a date, so the label leaves the reader to infer what kind of arrival fact is being given.
finding.prototype: DR1 labels the same pair "Arrival date at destination" (app/views/dashboard.html:288).
finding.difference: Change the label to "Arrival date at destination" in the English and Welsh copy files for the dashboard feature. Do it in the same pass as cutting the card down to DR1's four pairs, since both edit the same block.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Arrival at destination" without the word date as the card label in DR1's root dashboard view.
finding.correction: Nothing to correct. Both citations are exact to the line, both labels are visible in the two pictures, and both captured page models carry the wording verbatim — DR1's summary rows read Arrival date at destination on all four cards, the frontend's reads Arrival at destination. Kept separate from the card-fields finding rather than merged, which is right: renaming a label and deciding which four pairs a card carries are two different decisions, and folding the copy change inside the structural one would hide it.

relatedTo.why: the same card block, and the field this renames is one of the four DR1 keeps
